description: Test suite for the LudoRulesEngine, validating game logic including move legality, captures, safe cells, turn management, and win detection.

classes.name: LudoPieceId
classes.description: Identifier for a specific Ludo piece, including color and number.

classes.name: GameState
classes.description: Represents the current state of the game, including positions of pieces, active player, dice value, and game status.

classes.name: LudoMove
classes.description: Represents a move made by a player, including piece and dice value.

classes.name: PiecePosition
classes.description: Represents the position of a piece, such as on track, in yard, or in home stretch.

classes.name: LudoRulesEngine
classes.description: Contains static methods to enforce game rules such as move legality, applying moves, turn ending, and win detection.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point of the test suite executing various unit tests for Ludo game rules.
